sa-01: In childhood you swallowed the sun and the three worlds went dark; the world’s terror no one could remove. At the gods’ plea you released the sun and ended the distress. Who in the world does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-02: In fear of Bāli, Sugrīva lived on the mountain; the great Lord watched the path. After the sage’s curse, in a twice-born form you removed the servant’s sorrow. Who does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-03: With Aṅgada they went to find Sītā — the monkey-lord’s word: without news you will not live. Exhausted on the ocean shore, you brought news of Sītā and saved their lives. Who does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-04: Rāvaṇa tormented Sītā among the rākṣasīs. Hanumān slew the night-wanderers; when Sītā sought fire in the Aśoka grove, you gave the Lord’s ring and removed her grief. Who does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-05: When an arrow struck Lakṣmaṇa’s chest and Rāvaṇa’s son was slain, you brought Suṣeṇa and uprooted Mount Droṇa; placing the sañjīvanī in hand, you saved Lakṣmaṇa’s life. Who does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-06: In battle Rāvaṇa cast the serpent-noose; Rāma’s host was deluded. Hanumān brought Garuḍa, cut the bonds, and ended the terror. Who does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-07: When Ahirāvaṇa took Rāma and brother to the netherworld for sacrifice, you came as help and destroyed Ahirāvaṇa with his army. Who does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-08: You have done the great gods’ work — what distress of this poor one will not yield to you? Quickly remove, O great Lord, whatever crisis is ours. Who does not know your name — Kapī Saṅkaṭamocana?
sa-doha: Red body glowing red, wearing a red tail-cloth; thunderbolt body, crusher of demons — victory, victory, victory, heroic monkey!
